div.div: مُتْرِبٌ Possessing much wealth; (T, K;) rich; without want; or having wealth like the dust, or earth: (Lh and M: [in the TA, اترب is mentioned as having this meaning; perhaps by a mistranscription: if not, it must be ↓ أَتْرَبُ :]) and having little wealth: thus it bears two contr. significations: (K:) but the former is the more known. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
